Notify only: detects no progress, falling recognition scores, new windows and slowdowns, and only records them.
Up to value tuning: tries changing values such as re-capturing images or wait times, and reverts if things get worse.
Up to fix proposals: proposes adding or changing steps; applied only after a person approves.
